description: This file defines a React functional component for a Settings page in a Next.js project. The page manages notification settings for Slack and Email, including loading configurations, updating settings, and testing notifications. It also integrates with backend API functions and UI components for OAuth connections and organization ID prompts.

methods.name: pickConfig
methods.description: Selects the relevant notification configuration for a given provider and organization ID, prioritizing org-scoped configs.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches notification configurations for the current organization and updates the component state accordingly.

methods.name: saveSlack
methods.description: Saves the Slack notification configuration and reloads the data.

methods.name: saveEmail
methods.description: Saves the Email notification configuration and reloads the data.

methods.name: sendTest
methods.description: Sends a test notification to verify notification delivery for the current organization.
